vsm1.1:113.2: tesu yassa kassaci bhikkhuno ājīvaṃ parisodhentassa cīvare ca piṇḍapāte ca nimittobhāsaparikathāviññattiyo na vaṭṭanti.
vsm1.1:114.1: Tattha nimittaṃ nāma senāsanatthaṃ bhūmiparikammādīni karontassa ‘‘kiṃ, bhante, kariyati, ko kārāpetī’’ti gihīhi vutte ‘‘na koci’’ti paṭivacanaṃ,
vsm1.1:114.3: Obhāso nāma ‘‘upāsakā tumhe kuhiṃ vasathā’’ti. Pāsāde, bhanteti.
vsm1.1:114.4: ‘‘Bhikkhūnaṃ pana upāsakā pāsādo na vaṭṭatī’’ti vacanaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi evarūpaṃ obhāsakammaṃ.
vsm1.1:114.5: Parikathā nāma ‘‘bhikkhusaṅghassa senāsanaṃ sambādha’’nti vacanaṃ, yā vā panaññāpi evarūpā pariyāyakathā.
vsm1.1:115.2: Tathā uppannaṃ pana bhesajjaṃ roge vūpasante paribhuñjituṃ vaṭṭati, na vaṭṭatīti.
vsm1.1:115.3: Tattha vinayadharā ‘‘bhagavatā dvāraṃ dinnaṃ, tasmā vaṭṭatī’’ti vadanti.
vsm1.1:115.5: ājīvaṃ pana kopeti, tasmā na vaṭṭati’’cceva vadanti.
vsm1.1:116.1: Yo pana bhagavatā anuññātāpi nimittobhāsaparikathāviññattiyo akaronto appicchatādiguṇeyeva nissāya jīvitakkhayepi paccupaṭṭhite
vsm1.1:116.2: aññatreva obhāsādīhi uppannapaccaye paṭisevati, esa ‘‘paramasallekhavuttī’’ti vuccati,
vsm1.1:117.1: So kirāyasmā ekasmiṃ samaye pavivekaṃ brūhayamāno mahāmoggallānattherena saddhiṃ aññatarasmiṃ araññe viharati,
vsm1.1:117.2: athassa ekasmiṃ divase udaravātābādho uppajjitvā atidukkhaṃ janesi.
vsm1.1:117.3: Mahāmoggallānatthero sāyanhasamaye tassāyasmato upaṭṭhānaṃ gato theraṃ nipannaṃ disvā taṃ pavattiṃ pucchitvā
vsm1.1:117.4: ‘‘pubbe te, āvuso, kena phāsu hotī’’ti pucchi.
vsm1.1:117.5: Thero āha, ‘‘gihikāle me, āvuso, mātā sappimadhusakkarādīhi yojetvā asambhinnakhīrapāyāsaṃ adāsi, tena me phāsu ahosī’’ti.
vsm1.1:117.6: Sopi āyasmā ‘‘hotu, āvuso, sace mayhaṃ vā tuyhaṃ vā puññaṃ atthi, appeva nāma sve labhissāmā’’ti āha.
vsm1.1:118.1: Imaṃ pana nesaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ caṅkamanakoṭiyaṃ rukkhe adhivatthā devatā sutvā ‘‘sve ayyassa pāyāsaṃ uppādessāmī’’ti tāvadeva
vsm1.1:118.2: therassa upaṭṭhākakulaṃ gantvā jeṭṭhaputtassa sarīraṃ āvisitvā pīḷaṃ janesi.
vsm1.1:118.3: Athassa tikicchānimittaṃ sannipatite ñātake āha – ‘‘sace sve therassa evarūpaṃ nāma pāyāsaṃ paṭiyādetha, taṃ muñcissāmī’’ti.
vsm1.1:118.4: Te ‘‘tayā avuttepi mayaṃ therānaṃ nibaddhaṃ bhikkhaṃ demā’’ti vatvā dutiyadivase tathārūpaṃ pāyāsaṃ paṭiyādiyiṃsu.
vsm1.1:119.1: Mahāmoggallānatthero pātova āgantvā ‘‘āvuso, yāva ahaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā āgacchāmi, tāva idheva hohī’’ti vatvā gāmaṃ pāvisi.
vsm1.1:119.2: Te manussā paccuggantvā therassa pattaṃ gahetvā vuttappakārassa pāyāsassa pūretvā adaṃsu.
vsm1.1:119.4: Te ‘‘bhuñjatha – bhante, tumhe, aparampi dassāmā’’ti theraṃ bhojetvā puna pattapūraṃ adaṃsu.
vsm1.1:119.6: Theropi taṃ disvā ‘‘atimanāpo pāyāso, kathaṃ nu kho uppanno’’ti cintento
vsm1.1:119.7: tassa uppattimūlaṃ disvā āha – ‘‘āvuso moggallāna, aparibhogāraho piṇḍapāto’’ti.
vsm1.1:120.1: Sopāyasmā ‘‘mādisena nāma ābhataṃ piṇḍapātaṃ na paribhuñjatī’’ti cittampi anuppādetvā ekavacaneneva pattaṃ mukhavaṭṭiyaṃ gahetvā ekamante nikujjesi.
vsm1.1:120.2: Pāyāsassa saha bhūmiyaṃ patiṭṭhānā therassa ābādho antaradhāyi,
vsm1.1:120.3: tato paṭṭhāya pañcacattālīsa vassāni na puna uppajji.
vsm1.1:121.1: Tato mahāmoggallānaṃ āha – ‘‘āvuso, vacīviññattiṃ nissāya uppanno pāyāso antesu nikkhamitvā bhūmiyaṃ carantesupi paribhuñjituṃ ayuttarūpo’’ti.
vsm1.1:121.2: Imañca udānaṃ udānesi – ‘‘Vacīviññattivipphārā, uppannaṃ madhupāyasaṃ; Sace bhutto bhaveyyāhaṃ, sājīvo garahito mama. ‘‘Yadipi me antaguṇaṃ, nikkhamitvā bahi care; Neva bhindeyyaṃ ājīvaṃ, cajamānopi jīvitaṃ. ‘‘Ārādhemi sakaṃ cittaṃ, vivajjemi anesanaṃ; Nāhaṃ buddhappaṭikuṭṭhaṃ, kāhāmi ca anesana’’nti.
vsm1.1:122.2: Evaṃ sabbathāpi. ‘‘Anesanāya cittampi, ajanetvā vicakkhaṇo; Ājīvaṃ parisodheyya, saddhāpabbajito yatī’’ti.
vsm1.1:123.5: Tasmā pahāya paccayagedhaṃ dhammena samena uppanne paccaye yathāvuttena vidhinā paññāya paccavekkhitvā paribhuñjantena sampādetabbaṃ.
vsm1.1:124.1: Tattha duvidhaṃ paccavekkhaṇaṃ paccayānaṃ paṭilābhakāle, paribhogakāle ca.
vsm1.1:124.2: Paṭilābhakālepi hi dhātuvasena vā paṭikūlavasena vā paccavekkhitvā ṭhapitāni cīvarādīni tato uttari paribhuñjantassa anavajjova paribhogo, paribhogakālepi.
vsm1.1:125.2: Cattāro hi paribhogā theyyaparibhogo, iṇaparibhogo, dāyajjaparibhogo, sāmiparibhogoti.
vsm1.1:125.3: Tatra saṅghamajjhepi nisīditvā paribhuñjantassa dussīlassa paribhogo theyyaparibhogo nāma.
vsm1.1:125.5: Tasmā cīvaraṃ paribhoge paribhoge paccavekkhitabbaṃ, piṇḍapāto ālope ālope,
vsm1.1:125.7: Sacassa apaccavekkhatova aruṇaṃ uggacchati, iṇaparibhogaṭṭhāne tiṭṭhati.
vsm1.1:125.10: Evaṃ santepi paṭiggahaṇe satiṃ katvā paribhoge akarontasseva āpatti,
vsm1.1:125.11: paṭiggahaṇe pana satiṃ akatvā paribhoge karontassa anāpatti.
vsm1.1:126.6: Tañhi ‘‘na puna evaṃ karissāmī’’ti cittādhiṭṭhānasaṃvareneva sujjhanato saṃvarasuddhīti vuccati.
vsm1.1:126.8: Tañhi anesanaṃ pahāya dhammena samena paccaye uppādentassa pariyesanāya suddhattā pariyeṭṭhisuddhīti vuccati.
vsm1.1:126.10: Tañhi vuttappakārena paccavekkhaṇena sujjhanato paccavekkhaṇasuddhīti vuccati.
vsm1.1:126.11: Tena vuttaṃ ‘‘paṭiggahaṇe pana satiṃ akatvā paribhoge karontassa anāpattī’’ti.
vsm1.1:127.2: Te hi bhagavato puttā, tasmā pitusantakānaṃ paccayānaṃ dāyādā hutvā te paccaye paribhuñjanti.
vsm1.1:127.3: Kiṃpanete bhagavato paccaye paribhuñjanti, udāhu gihīnaṃ paccaye paribhuñjantīti.
vsm1.1:127.4: Gihīhi dinnāpi bhagavatā anuññātattā bhagavato santakā honti,
vsm1.1:127.8: Te hi taṇhāya dāsabyaṃ atītattā sāmino hutvā paribhuñjanti.
vsm1.1:128.1: Imesu paribhogesu sāmiparibhogo ca dāyajjaparibhogo ca sabbesaṃ vaṭṭati.
vsm1.1:128.5: so iṇaparibhogassa paccanīkattā āṇaṇyaparibhogo vā hoti, dāyajjaparibhogeyeva vā saṅgahaṃ gacchati.
vsm1.1:128.6: Sīlavāpi hi imāya sikkhāya samannāgatattā sekkhotveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.
vsm1.1:129.1: Imesu pana paribhogesu yasmā sāmiparibhogo aggo, tasmā taṃ patthayamānena bhikkhunā vuttappakārāya paccavekkhaṇāya paccavekkhitvā paribhuñjantena paccayasannissitasīlaṃ sampādetabbaṃ. Evaṃ karonto hi kiccakārī hoti.
vsm1.1:129.2: Vuttampi cetaṃ – ‘‘Piṇḍaṃ vihāraṃ sayanāsanañca, Āpañca saṅghāṭirajūpavāhanaṃ; Sutvāna dhammaṃ sugatena desitaṃ, Saṅkhāya seve varapaññasāvako. ‘‘Tasmā hi piṇḍe sayanāsane ca, Āpe ca saṅghāṭirajūpavāhane; Etesu dhammesu anūpalitto, Bhikkhu yathā pokkhare vāribindu. (su. ni. 393-394);
vsm1.1:129.3: ‘‘Kālena laddhā parato anuggahā, Khajjesu bhojjesu ca sāyanesu ca; Mattaṃ sa jaññā satataṃ upaṭṭhito, Vaṇassa ālepanarūhane yathā.
vsm1.1:129.4: ‘‘Kantāre puttamaṃsaṃva, akkhassabbhañjanaṃ yathā; Evaṃ āhāre āhāraṃ, yāpanatthamamucchito’’ti.
vsm1.1:130.1: Imassa ca paccayasannissitasīlassa paripūrakāritāya bhāgineyyasaṅgharakkhitasāmaṇerassa vatthu kathetabbaṃ.
vsm1.1:130.3: Yathāha – ‘‘Upajjhāyo maṃ bhuñjamānaṃ, sālikūraṃ sunibbutaṃ; Mā heva tvaṃ sāmaṇera, jivhaṃ jhāpesi asaññato.
vsm1.1:130.4: ‘‘Upajjhāyassa vaco sutvā, saṃvegamalabhiṃ tadā; Ekāsane nisīditvā, arahattaṃ apāpuṇiṃ.
vsm1.1:130.5: ‘‘Sohaṃ paripuṇṇasaṅkappo, cando pannaraso yathā; Sabbāsavaparikkhīṇo, natthi dāni punabbhavo’’ti.
vsm1.1:130.6: ‘‘Tasmā aññopi dukkhassa, patthayanto parikkhayaṃ; Yoniso paccavekkhitvā, paṭisevetha paccaye’’ti.
